summary: Your private Files workspace and steadier conversations.

improvements: Files has its own workspace for folders, transfers, and organization history.
You can move files into folders beyond the first page of results.
fixes: A disconnected chat checks queued-message delivery before sending another turn.
Files search keeps its current-page scope visible on smaller screens.
security: Files setup still requires your exact approval before changing your pod.
Connector review remains bound to the requested tool and owner.
